 Football
 Soccer-Barcelona bounce back with 6-1 win over Alaves
 By Ruairidh Barlow 
 Sunday, 01 Nov 2026
 | 6:08 AM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 Soccer Football - LaLiga - FC Barcelona v Deportivo Alaves - Spotify Camp Nou, Barcelona, Spain - October 31, 2026 FC Barcelona's Lamine Yamal celebrates scoring their fourth goal with Raphinha REUTERS/Albert Gea 
 Oct 31 (Reuters) - Barcelona enjoyed an ⁠emphatic 6-1 home win overAlaves on Saturday, with Raphinha,Fermin Lopez, Lamine Yamal and Anthony Gordon all on the scoresheet, ⁠as the hosts responded after losses to Real Madrid and Paris St Germain.
 Barca top LaLiga on 30 ‌points, two ahead of Atletico Madrid, who beat Levante 2-0 earlier on Saturday, with Real Madrid six points off the pace before visiting Racing Santander on Sunday.
 The opening exchanges at Camp Nou were punctuated by frustrated shouts fromhome manager Hansi Flick in response to Barcelona's defending, but Alaves found it impossible ​to live with their fluid attacking play.
 AfterPedri's pass sliced through the Alaves midfield, ⁠Fermin crossed for Raphinha to open the scoring ⁠in the eighth minute.
 A briefAlaves reaction put the hosts under pressure but once Fermin netted from a tight angle in ⁠the ‌23rd minute, the game was one-way traffic in Barcelona's favour.
 Tenacious and incisive throughout,Fermin assisted Raphinha again in the 41st minuteafter winning possession back.
 Lamine rifled a bouncing ball low into the corner to complete a slick passing move, addingBarcelona's fourth ⁠in first-half stoppage time.
 Flick's side continued to look sharp andKarim Adeyemi spurned ​a chance to round off more excellent ‌work from Fermin early in the second half. Lamine was set up by substitute Gabriel Jesus for his ⁠second in the 64th ​minute.
 Rodri was visibly delighted with the weight of his pass behind the Alaves defence, which Gordon converted for Barcelona's sixth with nine minutes remaining.
 The Spain midfielder was equally furious with himself after his giveaway allowedMariano Diaz to add a consolation goal for Alaves three minutes later.
 "This is ⁠what I want to see after two defeats. How we reacted, ​it was good and in the right way," Flick said.
 MISSING VERVE
 Barca showed the verve they were missing in the 2-1 Clasico defeat by visitors Real, after which Flick said his team lacked freshness, and a 4-2 loss at PSG in the Champions League.
 Aston Villa ⁠visit the Catalan side on Tuesday in the Champions League in what is likely to be a sterner test.
 Midfielders Brian Farinas and Frenkie de Jong started in defence for Barcelona due to injuries, and Flick did not confirm when Jules Kounde, Andreas Christensen or Eric Garcia would return.
 "We have to survive these two games (before the international break). We don't know who is coming ​back," said Flick.
 Diego Simeone won his 344th match as Atletico Madrid manager in a victory ⁠over Levante, equalling Luis Aragones' record in 192 fewer games.
 Goals fromAlejandro Grimaldo and Giuliano Simeone in each half were enough to secure ​a seventh straight victory in domestic competition.
 Fourth-placed Real Betis are revelling in their ‌best start to a LaLiga season through 11 games since ​1934, following a 2-1 win over Malaga.
 RayoVallecano moved level on 12 points with Celta Vigo after beating the Galician side 3-0, despite having played a game less.
 (Reporting by Ruairidh Barlow, editing by Ed Osmond and Ken Ferris)
